Iran sent contradictory signals: government spokesperson Mohajerani said Iran is 'fully prepared for effective participation,' while Iranian NOC Secretary General Alinejad at the Asian Beach Games in Sanya cautioned it's 'not my decision — it is the government's.' Lamine Yamal suffered a hamstring tear in Barcelona's win over Celta Vigo — out for the club season but expected to recover in time for Spain's June 15 World Cup opener. Toronto reversed its Fan Fest ticket policy, making 15,600 of 20,000 daily tickets free after public backlash. Days to kickoff updated to 49.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Tracker Update — Apr 22, 2026
summary: The two-week US-Iran ceasefire reached its April 22 deadline with Trump extending the terms but maintaining a naval blockade of Iranian ports — which Iran called an 'act of war' and refused to negotiate under. The extension moves the window past the April 30 FIFA Congress in Vancouver (8 days away), the formal decision point for Iran's World Cup participation, without resolving the core security dispute. Separately, FIFA released a new ticket inventory for all 104 matches on April 22 at 11 AM ET — exactly 50 days before the June 11 opener — with the $60 Supporter Entry Tier available on a first-come, first-served basis. Days-to-kickoff countdown updated to 50.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Tracker Update — Apr 21, 2026
summary: Iran Sports Minister Ahmad Donyamali declared 'maybe the decision is not to go' on April 21, directly contradicting FIFA President Infantino's April 18 assurance that Iran is 'coming for sure.' The final decision rests with Iran's Supreme National Security Council and is contingent on verifiable US player safety guarantees — the FIFA Congress in Vancouver on April 30 (9 days away) is the formal decision point. On April 20, Kansas City's $15 round-trip World Cup shuttle highlighted a sharp contrast to NJ Transit's $150 fare that continues to generate national backlash, while Fox Sports ran an Alexi Lalas lookalike stunt at the Boston Marathon promoting Gillette Stadium's seven World Cup matches. Days to kickoff updated to 51.
